about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Yassamin Ansari

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCERNS ON PROLIFERATION OF DATA CENTERS
statements.title: CONCERNS ON PROLIFERATION OF DATA CENTERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week, Donald Trump attacked communities across the country that are raising concerns about the proliferation of gigantic, power-hungry data centers.

According to the President, Americans should welcome data centers without question if they want to become ``successful and rich.'' His exact declaration was: ``Let data reign.'' That is a wildly out-of-touch response to Americans who are worried about their electricity bills, their water supply, and the future of their communities, all of which are being made dramatically worse by this administration.
I represent Phoenix, Arizona, the Nation's fifth largest city, and we don't need any more data centers in our communities right now.
Meanwhile, a single data center can consume tens if not hundreds of millions of gallons of water every year.
If every currently planned project in the Phoenix area is built, data center water demand could increase by more than 450 percent.

It is extremely alarming, and my constituents are right to express their concerns on how our government allocates its resources, including by providing immense tax breaks to ultra-rich AI and data center companies.
Arizona families are facing higher utility bills, most especially as a result of Trump's illegal war in Iran, all while data centers demand staggering amounts of energy.
Even Vice President JD Vance admitted that 99 percent--his words--of the backlash against data centers is happening in places where they are driving up utility bills.

Keeping electricity affordable enough for seniors to turn their air conditioners on during the summer is not poor, and allowing the wealthiest companies on the planet to consume our water and power while working families absorb the cost is not progress.

But here is the real reason that Donald Trump is so eager to tell communities to stop pushing back against data centers: Donald Trump is the sole beneficiary of a trust holding nearly 115 million shares of Trump Media.
Trump Media is pursuing a pending $6 billion merger with TAE Technologies, an energy company that explicitly markets its technology for AI data center expansion.
In other words, the President himself has an enormous financial interest in a company positioning itself to benefit from the growth of the data center energy market.
That creates a glaring conflict of interest when it comes to Trump using the power and platform of the Presidency to attack communities resisting the construction of new data centers.
Arizona should not approve another massive data center until we have a comprehensive plan to protect our water, our electrical grid, and Arizona ratepayers.
Congress also needs to investigate the President's conflict of interest and demand full transparency about how financial holdings intersect with his administration's data center and energy policies.
We are tired of being told to sacrifice more so that billionaires and the President himself can become richer.
I support Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes' call for a statewide pause.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ACCOUNTABILITY FOR ICE
statements.title: ACCOUNTABILITY FOR ICE
sentences: Madam Speaker, ICE, the President's paramilitary secret police force, continues to roam American streets and murder people in broad daylight and in cold blood.

Yet, it continues to happen in service of arbitrary, brutal quotas for bodies--quotas for bodies of real people to fill beds so that for-profit prison companies like GEO Group and CoreCivic can rake in billions of dollars and families can be torn apart and deported to third countries they have never known.

It is outrageous that ICE is claiming Lorenzo ``weaponized his vehicle in an attempt to run over an ICE law enforcement officer.'' Multiple witnesses have testified that there were never any ICE agents in front of the van.
ICE murdered another person in Maine, 26-year-old Joan Sebastian Guerrero, somebody who had a work permit, somebody who had a U.S. Social Security number.
We are a nation of laws, not a nation of secret police, cold-blooded murders by Federal agents on city streets, and black site detention centers.
We must abolish ICE, and we are going to prosecute every single person responsible for directing, enabling, or carrying out these crimes.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING WORK AUTHORIZATION FOR ELIGIBLE IRANIAN NATIONALS
statements.title: PROVIDING WORK AUTHORIZATION FOR ELIGIBLE IRANIAN NATIONALS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Iranian Temporary Immigration Relief Act, legislation I introduced alongside Congressman Tom Suozzi to provide temporary protected status and work authorization to eligible Iranian nationals already living in the United States.
They are shared by thousands of Iranian students and researchers who now find themselves caught in uncertainty through no fault of their own.
I heard from a Ph.D. researcher working on artificial intelligence for power grid reliability, crucial in my State.

I also heard from an Iranian Ph.D. student in public health whose husband waited nearly 2 years in administrative processing for a dependent visa, only to be ultimately denied after chaotic Trump policies prevented him from getting the visa he was promised.

These students and researchers are conducting NIH-funded cancer research, developing biomedical technologies, strengthening artificial intelligence systems, improving public health, advancing clean energy reliability, and helping American universities and employers remain globally competitive.

Now, after years of education and contribution, we are telling them they may not be allowed to continue their work and could be forced to return to Iran amid a dire human rights crisis worsened by ongoing hostilities and increased repression by the Islamic Republic.
Many Iranians residing in the United States have participated in anti-Islamic Republic regime and prodemocracy demonstrations in recent years, putting them at greater risk of persecution in Iran.
My bill grants temporary protected status and work authorization to eligible Iranian nationals legally present in the United States while their immigration matters remain pending.
As the first Iranian-American Democrat elected to Congress, I know personally how deeply these stories resonate across our communities, but this issue is larger than any one community.
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support the Iranian Temporary Immigration Relief Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8646, AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027; PROVIDING FOR C
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8646, AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7726, NO...
sentences: The people who stormed the Capitol, attacked police officers, submitted fake electors, lied to election officials, and called to ``hang Mike Pence'' deserve jail time, not my constituents' taxpayer dollars.

While Americans struggle to afford healthcare and housing and their gas prices keep climbing as a result of the President's reckless and illegal war, Donald Trump is fixated not on the American people but on his $400 million ballroom, renaming the Kennedy Center, covering up the Epstein files, and this outrageous slush fund for insurrectionists and his political allies.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my Republican colleagues to join Democrats in voting to permanently block this slush fund for Oath Keepers and Proud Boys and stand up to Donald Trump.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TESTIMONY OF MS. JENA-LISA JONES, "SURVIVORS FIGHT FOR JUSTICE: EXPOSING EPSTEIN'S CRIMES IN PALM BEACH AND ACROSS THE WORLD"
statements.title: TESTIMONY OF MS. JENA-LISA JONES, "SURVIVORS FIGHT FOR JUSTICE: EXPOSING EPSTEIN'S CRIMES IN PALM BEACH AND ACROSS THE WORLD"
sentences: Mr. Speaker, on May 12, 2026, Oversight Committee Democrats convened the first-ever hearing to solicit testimony from survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's crimes.
The hearing, ``Survivors Fight for Justice: Exposing Epstein's Crimes in Palm Beach and Across the World,'' marked a critical step forward in the fight for justice and accountability.

On behalf of all the survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's crimes, I rise to include in the Record the testimony offered by Ms. Jena-Lisa Jones: Chairman, Ranking Member, and Members of Congress, my name is Jena-Lisa Jones.
I was 14 years old when I was abused by Jeffrey Epstein in Palm Beach.
We asked you to help us understand how Jeffrey Epstein was given a non-prosecution agreement, even though the government had evidence that he had sexually abused dozens of children, including me.
The Department of Justice released documents that exposed our names, our Social Security numbers, and deeply personal information.

If Congress and the Department of Justice truly want to do right by survivors, the path forward is not complicated: acknowledge the failures--when Jeffrey Epstein was set free in 2009, and again when our privacy was shattered earlier this year.
With respect to your ongoing investigations, please remember this: Jeffrey Epstein is dead.
The girls who were groomed by Ghislaine Maxwell and abused by Jeffrey Epstein should not be treated like criminals.
Jeffrey Epstein destroyed so many of our lives, and Ghislaine Maxwell helped him do it.

Find a way to bring closure to the story of Jeffrey Epstein--to allow survivors, and this country, to finally begin to move forward so that one day (and I pray soon) Jeffrey Epstein's name is no longer something we are forced to hear every single day.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HARNESSING ENERGY AT THERMAL SOURCES ACT OF 2026
statements.title: HARNESSING ENERGY AT THERMAL SOURCES ACT OF 2026
sentences: My constituents and Americans across the country are struggling under the rising costs of gas, groceries, and electricity from President Trump's tariffs and endless wars.
It provides 24/7 carbon-free energy and creates good jobs in the clean energy economy.
Paired with wind and solar, geothermal can help us break free from fossil fuels and build a reliable, homegrown energy system that we need to fight climate change and tackle the affordability crisis.
Mr. Speaker, I urge adoption, and I yield back the balance of my time.
Again, I strongly support geothermal energy development on our Federal lands.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION IS EMBOLDENED
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION IS EMBOLDENED
sentences: All the while, Donald Trump flaunts his White House ballroom and D.C. arch, with displays of nauseating corruption for his billionaire buddies in broad daylight.
Kushner was shaping U.S. foreign policy while simultaneously building relationships with foreign leaders that would later become financially valuable to him personally.

While Kushner and Trump ally and billionaire friend Steve Witkoff meet with Gulf countries about matters pertaining to U.S. national security, they are also directly involved with selling massive billion- dollar deals to friends and family of the President.
He is not subject to the rules and regulations of actual public servants, including background checks and requirements for security clearance.
He is negotiating America's foreign policy and matters of literal war and peace between the United States and Iran--some of the most consequential negotiations of the 21st century.

When Democrats take back the House in November, I will work to ensure that subpoenas fly out for every taxpayer dollar and cent that Trump and his family have spent during their time in office steering into their own pockets.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: As the daughter of Iranian immigrants who fled this regime, I know personally what its violence means.

At the same time, as an American Congresswoman, who swore an oath to the United States Constitution, I am deeply concerned by President Trump's decision to launch an illegal war--because it is, in fact, illegal--against Iran without congressional authorization and without presenting a clear plan to the American people.
I want nothing more than a free Iran and safety and security for innocent Iranians.
It requires seriousness, accountability, and a real plan to support the Iranian people in determining their own future.
Donald Trump has shown at every instance that freedom for the people of Iran is not his priority.
Ultimately, this vote is about the legitimacy of our democracy and our Constitution, and that is why I will be voting ``yes'' on the War Powers Resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
statements.title: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
sentences: With costs rising on everything that they need to live, housing, food, and childcare, they have been through enough.
The ACA enhanced premium tax credits were a lifeline for these families, but Republican inaction allowed these tax credits to expire on December 31 because they don't care about regular people.
For many families in Arizona, ACA marketplace premiums have already more than doubled as a result of Republican negligence.
She has relied on ACA coverage for 8 years, paying $350 a month.
Last year, she suffered a head injury that required emergency care, and ACA kept her bill around $1,000 instead of $10,000, saving her from potential bankruptcy.
The ACA is her lifeline, and without it, she could lose her home and everything else that she has built.
Today, the House of Representatives finally voted to extend these enhanced premium tax credits for 3 years.
We must apply pressure to the United States Senate to pass a clean 3-year extension of these ACA tax credits.
We need to pass Medicare for All.
That means Medicare for All before more Americans lose their healthcare or go into medical debt.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SCHOOL SHOOTINGS ARE NOT INEVITABLE
statements.title: SCHOOL SHOOTINGS ARE NOT INEVITABLE
sentences: That means universal background checks, a ban on assault weapons designed for mass killing, cracking down on ghost guns, and investing in mental health and safe storage policies grounded in data.
We cannot allow ourselves to become numb to this.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
statements.title: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
sentences: At the heart of this system sits a vast network of privatized detention facilities run by private prison corporations, like CoreCivic and GEO Group, whose bottom lines depend on filling these beds.

We can end blank checks for ICE and stop the privatization of immigration detention centers once and for all, and we can finally reject the lie that Trumpian cruelty is security because in America, our safety should never come second to a billion dollar corporation's profit.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING FOR EMPATHY IN THE FACE OF TRAGEDY
statements.title: CALLING FOR EMPATHY IN THE FACE OF TRAGEDY
sentences: Transgender Americans breathe it just stepping outside, never knowing if they will be targeted for simply existing as themselves.
We need to invest in connection in this country: in schools, in civic spaces, in mental health services, and in communities where people can see one another as human beings again.
When algorithms reward division and hate, that hate doesn't stay online.
Empathy is action against gun violence, the fear that stalks every one of us.
We need commonsense gun safety laws, and we need funding for mental health care.
Today it may be immigrants; tomorrow, transgender Americans; last week, a conservative political leader.
I am asking my colleagues: Resist the temptation to harden your hearts.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3838, STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026;
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3838, STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026; AND PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION...
sentences: The first amendment would have included a penalty in law for using artificial intelligence to impersonate Federal officials.
The second amendment I want to highlight speaks to a deeply disturbing issue that we all, both Republicans and Democrats, should be horrified by.
This is about the Trump administration's deportation of veterans and servicemembers, including an Iraq war veteran detained by ICE in my district, Arizona's Third.

This amendment to the NDAA would have required a study by the Defense Department and other relevant agencies on the procedures in place to assist noncitizen servicemembers with their citizenship applications.
This provision is identical to a bipartisan bill I introduced early this year titled: the AI Impersonation Prevention Act.
I introduced this bill to safeguard national security from the clear danger of the misuse of AI to impersonate Federal officials.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PUSHING BACK AGAINST ICE'S AUTHORITARIAN OVERREACH
statements.title: PUSHING BACK AGAINST ICE'S AUTHORITARIAN OVERREACH
sentences: This money makes ICE the largest domestic police force in the United States with more resources than dozens of militaries around the entire world.
I will always stand with and fight for our immigrant communities.
I will do everything I can to push back against Trump's authoritarian overreach. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: The original STOCK Act passed in 2012 bars a Member of Congress, the President, Vice President, and high-level staff from engaging in insider trading or otherwise using nonpublic information for their own benefit.
That is why I am so proud to cosponsor Congressman Magaziner's TRUST in Congress Act.

This bill would require Members of Congress and their immediate family members to divest from individual stock holdings or place them into a qualified blind trust during their entire tenure in Congress.
In practice, it would ban Members of Congress from trading stocks.
The TRUST in Congress Act and bills like it would prevent corruption and restore trust in Congress.

Before I was sworn in to Federal office, I made a personal effort to sell stocks that I had and to ensure that my financial future would not and could not be dependent on information that I might become privy to as a Member of the House of Representatives.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of long-overdue legislative measures to prevent Members of Congress from trading stock.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CLEANING UP GOVERNMENT
statements.title: CLEANING UP GOVERNMENT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as the first Iranian-American Democrat elected to Congress, I can tell you that the Persian community in the United States and across the world is outraged at the attempt to change the historically significant name.

That is why, today, I am proud to introduce the Persian Gulf Act to prohibit any Federal funds from being used to rename the body of water and prevent government documents from referring to the Persian Gulf by anything except that name.
As Donald Trump acts only for himself, I will continue fighting against his corruption and the American people.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MASS SHOOTING IN GLENDALE, ARIZONA
statements.title: MASS SHOOTING IN GLENDALE, ARIZONA
sentences: For far too long, we have been forced to watch as gun violence devastates our communities, and we feel unsafe going to the movies or eating out at a restaurant.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN REMEMBRANCE OF EL CAMARON GIGANTE VICTIMS
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE IN REMEMBRANCE OF EL CAMARON GIGANTE VICTIMS
sentences: I am heartbroken to say that my district has once again been touched by gun violence as far, far too many have.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
statements.title: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
sentences: In El Salvador, we met with the U.S. Ambassador and demanded that the Trump administration facilitate the release of Kilmar Abrego Garcia in compliance with the 9-0, unanimous Supreme Court decision of the United States and the lower Federal court judges.
It is outrageous and indefensible that the Trump administration continues to defy a Supreme Court ruling to return this man to his family.

There are other people--including Andry Jose Hernandez Romero, a makeup artist and legal asylum seeker, and Merwil Gutierrez, a teenager who was mistakenly picked up by immigration enforcement--languishing in El Salvador.
I will continue to speak out for due process and our constitutional rights.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OPPOSING LEGISLATIVE VOTER SUPPRESSION
statements.title: OPPOSING LEGISLATIVE VOTER SUPPRESSION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in firm opposition to the Republican passage of the so-called SAVE Act, an act of legislative voter suppression that will make it much harder for most people to vote, the cornerstone of our democracy.
Noncitizens are already not allowed to vote under Federal law.
Instances of fraudulent, noncitizen voting are exceedingly rare.
You are literally more likely to get struck by lightning than encounter noncitizen voting.

To address this made-up problem, Republicans have passed a draconian bill that would make it extremely difficult and costly for servicemembers, married women, and disadvantaged Americans to register to vote.

This bill also mandates in-person visits to register to vote, disenfranchising potentially tens of thousands of deployed servicemembers, as well as Native Americans in rural areas like northern Arizona.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECKLESS INCOMPETENCE OF SIGNAL CHAT PUT SERVICEMEMBERS AT RISK
statements.title: RECKLESS INCOMPETENCE OF SIGNAL CHAT PUT SERVICEMEMBERS AT RISK
sentences: This is the same man, after all, who had our nuclear codes sitting in his bathroom in Mar-a-Lago.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MIGRANTS FLEEING RELIGIOUS PERSECUTION
statements.title: MIGRANTS FLEEING RELIGIOUS PERSECUTION
sentences: This includes asylum seekers from Iran, China, and other countries known to persecute religious minorities.
Among them is Artemis Ghasemzadeh, an Iranian woman who fled Iran after converting to Christianity, a crime punishable by death under the brutal Islamic regime.
Artemis converted to Christianity in secret through a network of underground churches and online classes in Iran.
Artemis is 1 of 10 Iranian Christians, including 3 children, who are detained in Panama.
I am the proud daughter of immigrants from Iran.

This country welcomed them with open arms, allowed them to work hard and succeed, and in just one generation, they have witnessed their daughter make history as the first Iranian-American Democrat ever elected to Congress.
Asylum seekers come to this country to escape violence and persecution.
That is why I plan to introduce legislation that would halt expedited removal for individuals fleeing countries noted for persecuting religious minorities.
Mr. Speaker, I urge this administration to uphold our Nation's legacy as a beacon of hope and a defender of religious freedom, not a facilitator of suffering. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING AMERICAN ENERGY PRODUCTION ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING AMERICAN ENERGY PRODUCTION ACT
sentences: My constituents sent me to Congress to fight for them for clean water, clean air, job security, and lower prices.
H.R. 26 says that the President cannot issue a ban on fracking unless authorized by Congress.
It is obviously a little bit ridiculous that President Trump is not going to ban fracking.
In fact, no President has ever banned fracking.
What this bill is, is just an opportunity for some House Republicans to signal their support for their Big Oil allies and their billionaire friends.
When we drill more and more, the only ones who benefit are those at the top, the CEOs, the multinational corporations, and the already rich billionaires who are profiting off of the American people.
Big Oil is already getting at least $15 billion in subsidies from the Federal Government.

After promising lower prices for everyday Americans, the President is threatening a trade war with our closest allies which will drive up the costs to produce everything from energy to cars to technology.

The administration is threatening mass deportations of people who are part of the workforce and contributing to our economy, and the Republican-led Congress is plotting how to cut spending on healthcare and clean energy in order to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.
Madam Speaker, today, I rise in strong opposition to H.R. 26.
Madam Speaker, I strongly urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on H.R. 26.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING AMERICAN TAXPAYERS' SENSITIVE INFORMATION
statements.title: PROTECTING AMERICAN TAXPAYERS' SENSITIVE INFORMATION
sentences: Trump has handed over the government to Elon Musk, an unelected billionaire who does not care about the American people.
The Treasury makes 1.5 billion payments a year to taxpayers, businesses, and seniors, everything from Social Security benefits to tax refunds, Medicare, and Medicaid.
Musk now has access to Americans' confidential tax refund information, which includes their names, Social Security numbers, and home addresses.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 9/11 MEMORIAL AND MUSEUM ACT
statements.title: 9/11 MEMORIAL AND MUSEUM ACT
sentences: I rise in support of the 9/11 Memorial and Museum Act.
We will forever strive to honor the innocent lives lost and reckon with the sacrifices of so many.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ALASKA NATIVE SETTLEMENT TRUST ELIGIBILITY ACT
statements.title: ALASKA NATIVE SETTLEMENT TRUST ELIGIBILITY ACT
sentences: Moreover, this bill will be of small comfort if Republicans make good on their promises to cut need-based Federal programs to pay for their billionaire tax breaks.
I rise in support of Representative Begich's H.R. 42, the Alaska Native Settlement Trust Eligibility Act.
I will remind my colleagues, though, that this bill of course, doesn't remove the risk that this administration will try to illegally freeze or pause anyone's Federal benefits.

Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill, but I also urge them to oppose the lawlessness we have been seeing in the administration and to oppose cuts to programs that help the most vulnerable people in our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ALASKA NATIVE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL LANDS RESTORATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: ALASKA NATIVE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL LANDS RESTORATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of Representative Begich's H.R. 43, the Alaska Native Village Municipal Lands Restoration Act of 2025.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill, which will allow communities themselves to make decisions about how best to utilize their own lands.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EASTERN BAND OF CHEROKEE HISTORIC LANDS REACQUISITION ACT
statements.title: EASTERN BAND OF CHEROKEE HISTORIC LANDS REACQUISITION ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of the Eastern Band of Cherokee Historic Lands Reacquisition Act introduced by Representative Fleischmann of Tennessee.
Even if this bill becomes law, we will need actual staffing in the executive branch to carry it out.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this bill, but I also urge them to join Democrats in calling for an end to the paralyzing chaos we have been seeing from the White House.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NUTRIA ERADICATION AND CONTROL REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NUTRIA ERADICATION AND CONTROL REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of this bill, which would reauthorize the Nutria Eradication and Control Act through fiscal year 2030, to ensure that Maryland, Louisiana, and California can manage and eradicate this destructive, invasive species.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING MILAGROS HEREDIA
statements.title: SUPPORTING MILAGROS HEREDIA
sentences: Milagros was a baby when her mother carried her across the border for a better life.
Like many Dreamers, she lives in constant fear of losing everything.
Because of executive orders proposed by President Trump and the Laken Riley Act, Milagros and more than 20,000 Dreamers in Arizona live in fearful uncertainty.
It is past time for Congress to provide a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers and for Democrats to stand up to Trump's un-American policies. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose the GOP child predator empowerment act.
I urge a strong ``no'' on this legislation because I believe we should make our children safer, not empower adult strangers to investigate their most private physicality.
